decision: Retain the upstream wrapper plus per-project partial-SRG contract already present in the migrated code. Correct the installed-consumer fixture using its installed template hooks; do not substitute engine fallback SRGs or delete scene/view data. No PR code automatically adopted. The separate unconditional Terrain include is not fixed by this PR and still requires a local owner/deployment decision after exact consumer tracing.
limits: Read-only research. No source/SDK/fixture changes, no native job, no GPU/RT dispatch or acceptance. Empty scoped searches do not establish universal absence of other fixes.
